name: codelab
description: CodeLab — the Full-Stack Engineer Path sandbox course inside Academy.
comment: playwright-core is deliberate: it drives an EXISTING browser and downloads no
binaries. The full 'playwright' package fetches its own Chromium, which Smart
App Control blocks on this machine.
tools/validate.js finds a browser in this order: CHROMIUM_PATH, then installed
Chrome, then Edge, then the Linux CI path. Set CHROMIUM_PATH to override.
